name: 吞咽困难食物分级筛选

map.基于 IDDSI 国际吞咽障碍食物标准，筛选推荐与避免的食物: Screen recommended and avoided foods based on the IDDSI international dysphagia diet standard
map.📖 查看「吞咽困难食物分级筛选使用指南」: 📖 View the "Dysphagia Food Grade Screening Guide"
map.按 IDDSI 国际吞咽障碍饮食标准分 8 级：0 级稀薄液体、1 级微稠、2: By the IDDSI international dysphagia diet standard, 8 levels: level 0 thin liquid, 1 slightly thick, 2 mildly thick, 3 moderately thick (liquid), 4 extremely thick (puree), 5 minced and moist, 6 soft and bite-sized (each piece ≤ 1.5 cm), 7 regular easy-to-chew; thicken liquids to levels 1-4, choose solids by measured swallowing ability; avoid sticky, easily crumbly and mixed solid-liquid foods (e.g. rice soup, nuts) to prevent aspiration.
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供参考。吞咽困难患者饮食方案请遵医嘱，进食时需有人陪护。: ⚠️ This tool is for reference only. Dysphagia patients' diet plans should follow medical advice; someone should accompany during meals.
map.国际吞咽障碍食物标准行动委员会分级: International Dysphagia Diet Standardisation Initiative grading
map.使用增稠剂（如黄原胶、淀粉类）调制: Use thickeners (e.g. xanthan gum, starch-based) to adjust
map.花蜜状：倾斜杯子缓慢流动: Nectar-like: flows slowly when the cup is tilted
map.蜂蜜状：用勺子舀起缓慢滑落: Honey-like: drips slowly when lifted with a spoon
map.布丁状：勺子倾斜几乎不流动: Pudding-like: barely flows when the spoon is tilted
map.烹饪至软烂，可用筷子轻松分开: Cook until soft and easily separated with chopsticks
map.肉类需剁碎或打泥: Meat must be minced or pureed
map.蔬菜需煮至筷子可夹断: Vegetables must be cooked until chopsticks can cut through
map.坐直90度进食，餐后保持30分钟: Sit upright at 90 degrees to eat; stay upright 30 minutes after meals
map.每口3-5ml，充分咀嚼后吞咽: 3-5 ml per bite; chew fully before swallowing
map.干湿食物分开喂食，避免误吸: Feed dry and wet foods separately to avoid aspiration
map.进食时避免说话、大笑: Avoid talking or laughing while eating
map.餐后检查口腔有无残留: Check mouth for residue after meals
map.本工具基于 IDDSI 国际吞咽障碍食物标准，帮助吞咽困难患者、家属和护理人员选: This tool is based on the IDDSI international dysphagia diet standard, helping dysphagia patients, families and caregivers choose a suitable food thickness level and reduce aspiration risk.
map.按 IDDSI（国际吞咽障碍饮食标准）0–7 级，为不同严重度吞咽障碍者筛选安全: By IDDSI (international dysphagia diet standard) levels 0-7, screen safe food texture for dysphagia of different severity.
map.对照每级的稠度描述与适用人群，避免「稀薄易误吸」或「过硬难咽」的风险错配。: Compare each level's thickness description and suitable population to avoid mismatch risk of 'thin and easy to aspirate' or 'too hard to swallow'.
map.为照护者提供分级清单，统一居家与机构饮食的一致性。: Provide caregivers a graded checklist to unify home and institutional diet consistency.
map.场景：中度吞咽障碍（如卒中后）患者。\nIDDSI 将食物分为 0 稀薄–7 常:
Scenario: moderate dysphagia (e.g. post-stroke) patient. 
 IDDSI divides food into 8 levels from 0 thin to 7 regular: 0-3 are drink thickness (thin/slightly/mildly/extremely thick), 4-7 are food (extremely thick/minced and moist/soft and bite-sized/regular). 
 Screening: moderate impairment should choose level 5 'minced and moist'—uniform texture, easy to form a bolus, needs little chewing, lowering aspiration risk; avoid level 0 thin liquid (fastest flow, easiest to choke into the airway). 
 Conclusion: this patient's safe range is levels 4-5; thin liquids must be thickened to levels 1-3 before drinking.
map.为什么稀薄的汤水反而最危险？: Why are thin soups and waters the most dangerous?
map.稀薄液体流速快、易在会厌关闭前涌入气道，是误吸性肺炎的高危因素。IDDSI 将「: Thin liquids flow fast and easily rush into the airway before the epiglottis closes, a high-risk factor for aspiration pneumonia. IDDSI lists 'thin' as level 0 (high risk); dysphagia patients must thicken or use a higher thickness level.
map.不是。吞咽功能随康复、疾病进展变化，应定期由言语治疗师重新评估并调整等级。本工具: No. Swallowing function changes with rehabilitation and disease progression; it should be re-assessed regularly by a speech therapist and the grade adjusted. This tool is a screening reference; the final grade must follow a professional videofluoroscopy/endoscopy conclusion.
